mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CT_NOTICE_FILE(CT_NOTICE_IDX, CT_NOTICE_FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, CT_NOTICE_FILE_SAVED_NAME, CT_NOTICE_FILE_SAVED_PATH, CT_NOTICE_FILE_CREATE_TIME) VALUES(#{ctNoticeIdx}, #{ctNoticeFileOriginalName},#{ctNoticeFileSavedName},#{ctNoticeFileSavedPath}, #{ctNoticeFileCreateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT CT_NOTICE_FILE_IDX AS ctNoticeFileIdx, CT_NOTICE_IDX AS ctNoticeIdx, CT_NOTICE_FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME AS ctNoticeFileOriginalName, CT_NOTICE_FILE_SAVED_NAME AS ctNoticeFileSavedName, CT_NOTICE_FILE_SAVED_PATH AS ctNoticeFileSavedPath, CT_NOTICE_FILE_CREATE_TIME AS ctNoticeFileCreateTime FROM ct_notice_file WHERE CT_NOTICE_IDX = #{ctNoticeIdx}
